en-US.name: Steady Noise Premium
en-US.summary: Pink and brown noise, and no time limit on any color.
en-US.description: Adds pink and brown noise to Steady Noise and removes the one hour limit, so any color plays all night or for a time you choose.
examplePhrases: Alexa, ask Steady Noise for brown noise
Alexa, ask Steady Noise to buy premium

customProductPrompts.purchasePromptDescription: Steady Noise Premium adds pink and brown noise and plays any color all night.
customProductPrompts.boughtCardDescription: You now have Steady Noise Premium: white, pink, and brown noise with no time limit.

inSkillProductDefinition.testingInstructions: Ask for pink or brown noise, or say 'buy premium'. Premium unlocks pink and brown and removes the one hour free limit.
